source.title: Call for Applications - WMCT Leader (October 2024)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Major Championship Team Leader. 


The WMCT Leader will ensure that the duties of the WMCT will be carried out in accordance with [WCA Motion 10.2024.14](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.14%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Team.pdf).


Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months). The commitment for the Major Championship Team is expected to be variable, with periods of intense activity and other periods with only minimal activity. The range is expected to be 2 - 10 hours per week.


The qualities expected of candidates are:

- Experience in organizing a WCA Major Championship
- Demonstrated project management expertise
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent knowledge of the activities and capabilities of the WCA Teams and Committees


The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until October 27th, 2024, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the Executive Assistant Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).


The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the WMCT Leader of the WCA.


Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.


After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 5 of [WCA Motion 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). 


Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 大型锦标赛组负责人招募（2024 年 10 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的大型锦标赛组（WMCT）负责人。

WMCT 负责人须确保团队依照 [WCA 动议 10.2024.14](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.14%20-%20Major%20Championship%20Team.pdf)履行职责。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期。大型锦标赛组的工作量会随阶段变化，有时工作密集，有时较少，预计每周需投入 2–10 小时。

申请人应具备以下条件：

- 有组织 WCA 大型锦标赛的经验
- 有经过实践证明的项目管理能力
- 出色的书面和口头沟通能力
- 熟悉 WCA 各团队和委员会的工作及能力范围

申请时间为即日起至 2024 年 10 月 27 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者请将材料私下发送至董事会助理团队（assistants@worldcubeassociation.org），并抄送 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

- 简短的个人介绍
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
- 担任 WMCT 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 动议 10.2024.0](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2024.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节投票选出并公布新任负责人。

感谢各位申请和支持。
